formal_title: Prospective Transport-Algebra Orientation Prediction, Left-Zero↔Right-Zero↔Larger-Monoid Fresh Classification, Minimal Faithful-State Precommit, Strong Property-Indexed Shared-Boundary Replication, Frozen Action-Sufficient Quotient, Prospective AND-Bridge Held-Out Transport, Decomposition-Uniqueness Stress & Macro-Structure Prediction

lane_A_transport_algebra.target: Fresh source-defined pair of idempotent semantic transformations D,R with both compositions executable.

classifier.condition: D∘R=D and R∘D=R, with I identity and D,R distinct idempotents
D∘R=R and R∘D=D, with I identity and D,R distinct idempotents
closure has >3 transformations or a generator/composite is non-idempotent

orientation_prediction_rule: If D and R both overwrite the same semantic coordinate unconditionally to distinct constants, classify LEFT_ZERO.
If D and R are state-conditional projections that each preserve the other's already-canonical fixed points while acting differently on a third legacy/source state, classify RIGHT_ZERO.
If both transformations commute on every predeclared state, classify COMMUTATIVE_IDEMPOTENT.
Otherwise classify LARGER_OR_NONBAND; do not force a band orientation.
lane_A_transport_algebra.strong_pass: Exact source-level transition table and hosted intervention agree with the preselected orientation class and minimum faithful degree.

lane_B_property_index.requirement: Same physical boundary/transformation acts differently on at least two predeclared properties, in one source/test packet.
lane_B_property_index.strong_pass: Property identities fixed before source outcome inspection; shared boundary yields distinct transport maps and hosted reproduction.

lane_C_bridge.Q: Binary action-sufficient visible state q∈{0,1}; q=1 iff arrived semantic property is action-sufficiently PRESENT/AVAILABLE under the frozen packet.
lane_C_bridge.G: Binary local gate g∈{0,1}; g=1 iff local geometry/authority allows the action independent of transport presence.
lane_C_bridge.held_out_requirement: Fresh mechanism must expose a 2×2 q×g packet or equivalent four matched cells without mechanism ID.
lane_C_bridge.strong_pass: All four held-out cells match AND: 00→0, 01→0, 10→0, 11→1.

mathematical_targets.statement: Exhaustively verify degree-2 impossibility for right-zero identity and degree-3 witness; verify left-zero degree 2.
Any quotient identifying D~R collapses left-zero and right-zero orientations to the same two-element idempotent monoid.
If a held-out 2×2 packet has exactly one positive cell at q=g=1 and zero elsewhere, AND is the unique Boolean function compatible with the packet.
Prospective U0 bridge authority requires a fresh held-out packet; retrospective fit cannot distinguish U0 from U1.

decomposition_rivals.claim: Path transport and surface-selection are linked by frozen binary Q and shared AND decision grammar.
Families remain distinct, but binary Q is a stable interface; AND bridge may hold only on a bounded subclass.
Fresh held-out bridge fails despite valid family-local laws.
Repairable/schema transport requires a separate family beyond simple carrier transport.
